blocks.content: We can easily convert distance in kilometers to miles using this formula:

Enter distance in km: 10
Distance in miles: 6.21

items: cin >> km; - takes distance input in km from the user and stores it in the km variable.
miles = km * conversion_ratio; - computes the distance in miles by multiplying the distance in km by 0.621.
